title: DNS Troubleshooting Runbook for WireGuard VPN
description: Comprehensive DNS troubleshooting procedures for WireGuard VPN with split tunneling configuration
author: AI Agent

operations.name: inspect_current_state
operations.description: Inspect current DNS and VPN state

commands.purpose: Check systemd-resolved state and DNS routing

expected_results: systemd-resolved shows VPN as DNS route
failure_indicators: DNS scope shows 'none' for VPN interface
Physical interface has higher DNS priority

commands.purpose: Check which DNS server is being used

failure_indicators: VPN interface not in DNS scope

operations.name: analyze_routing
operations.description: Analyze routing and split tunneling configuration

expected_results: WireGuard peer routes disabled for manual control

operations.name: configure_dns_priority
operations.description: Configure DNS priority to favor VPN resolver

commands.purpose: Set VPN DNS priority higher than physical interface

commands.command: nmcli connection modify 'Wired connection 3' ipv4.ignore-auto-dns yes
commands.purpose: Prevent physical interface from using DHCP DNS
commands.rollback: nmcli connection modify 'Wired connection 3' ipv4.ignore-auto-dns no

post_execution_commands: nmcli connection down wg0-et-gtw && nmcli connection up wg0-et-gtw
expected_results: VPN interface shows DNS scope with DefaultRoute
Physical interface has lower DNS priority

operations.name: test_dns_resolution
operations.description: Test DNS resolution after configuration changes

operations.name: packet_capture_analysis
operations.description: Optional packet capture to verify DNS routing

commands.purpose: Capture DNS packets on VPN interface
Capture DNS packets on physical interface

expected_results: DNS queries visible on VPN interface
No DNS queries on physical interface for internet domains
failure_indicators: No DNS queries on VPN interface

troubleshooting_scenarios.scenario: DNS scope disappears from VPN interface
symptoms: resolvectl shows 'Current Scopes: none' for wg0-et-gtw
causes: Connection reactivation without proper DNS setup
solutions: Adjust DNS priority values (lower = higher priority)

symptoms: Cannot access internet after setting 0.0.0.0/0 route
Default route changed to VPN interface
causes: VPN gateway doesn't provide internet routing
NAT not configured on VPN gateway

troubleshooting_scenarios.scenario: Browser shows Cloudflare DNS despite system configuration
symptoms: DNS leak test shows Cloudflare resolvers
solutions: Configure browser to use custom DNS server
Use packet capture to verify actual DNS traffic

best_practices: Always use read-only diagnostics before making changes
Test DNS resolution after each configuration change
Document working configurations for future reference
Use the runbook toolkit for all system modifications
Verify routing doesn't break internet connectivity
Monitor systemd-resolved state after connection changes

emergency_rollback.description: Immediate rollback procedures if DNS or connectivity breaks
commands: nmcli connection modify 'Wired connection 3' ipv4.ignore-auto-dns no
nmcli connection down wg0-et-gtw && nmcli connection up wg0-et-gtw

notes: Split tunneling with DNS routing is complex and may not work as expected
The fundamental issue is that DNS queries to internet domains don't match VPN subnets
Browser-level DNS configuration may be more reliable than system-level
Full tunnel VPN requires proper gateway configuration for internet access
Cloudflare DNS in leak tests may indicate browser DoH, not system misconfiguration
